scope: Queue-group study fragment; candidate generation and explicit visual reuse only, never full-catalog completion or asset approval.

entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D candidate object-modeling reference.
Input image 1 is a PRIVATE original inventory sprite, used only to preserve recognizable silhouette, colors, material regions and distinctive details. Create NEW HD imagery throughout; never paste the sprite into any view or thumbnail.
A clean technical board of the exact SAME single object in FRONT, SIDE, BACK, THREE-QUARTER and a small NEW HD INVENTORY thumbnail. All views must agree on geometry, proportions, material layout and distinctive details; back is the true reverse, not another front. Full object visible, generously spaced, plain charcoal-gray backdrop, neutral soft studio lighting, no colored illumination or glow, realistic restrained dark medieval materials and fine wear. No scene, body, face, hands, stand, exploded alternatives or extra props. Rear/hidden surfaces and absolute scale are proposed reconstruction; preserve visible source design. Thumbnail must be a new high-detail render of this same object, never pixel-art or the supplied sprite. Minimal labels: item name, FRONT, SIDE, BACK, 3/4, ICON.
Subject: Cap; item.design.base.cap; native cursor 91.
A dark olive-brown soft leather hood-like CAP with domed stitched crown, a prominent center seam, a rolled rim around a completely empty open face, and TWO hanging side earflaps ending in small gray metal fasteners. Preserve the original close rounded silhouette and earthy brown/olive material; dark interior is empty, not a face. No horns, crown spikes, eye visor, plume, face or metallic full helmet. Hidden stitching/interior lining is inferred.

reference.notes: Licensed original inventory sprite inspected privately at nearest-neighbor 6x enlargement; no original pixels or file paths are included.

inferredParts: Fine construction/material details unresolved by source pixels

entries.notes: Neutral-light candidate board. HD thumbnail is a new concept preview, not a final runtime icon. Hidden geometry is proposed reconstruction.
